## Statistics

This is not intended as a statistics course - if you are feeling a little rusty on stats here are some suggestions

[Statistics Refresher](stats_explained.qmd) - my short refresher focussed on the statistical concepts used in this course

[StatQuest](https://statquest.org/) a site and YouTube channel with accessible videos on a wide variety of statistical topics

[An Introduction to Statistical Learning](https://www.statlearning.com/) - a book on statistical concepts which provides a relatively maths-free run down of statistical concepts with example in R

[STATSREF: Statistical Analysis Handbook](https://www.statsref.com/) - a free online resource for statistics (again with lots of examples in R

[Statistical Rethinking](https://xcelab.net/rm/) - a lecture series and text book on Bayesian statistics and causal inference.
